label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 44

obligations.text:
Controller's general duties
(1)
The controller must make available to data subjects the following information (whether by making the information generally available to the public or in any other way)—
(a)
the identity and the contact details of the controller;

(2)
The controller must also, in specific cases for the purpose of enabling the exercise of a data subject's rights under this Part, give the data subject the following—
(a)
information about the legal basis for the processing;

(5)
Where the provision of information to a data subject under subsection (2) is restricted under subsection (4), wholly or partly, the controller must inform the data subject in writing without undue delay—
(a)
that the provision of information has been restricted,
(b)
of the reasons for the restriction,
(c)
of the data subject's right to make a request to the Commission under section 51,
(ca)
of the data subject’s right to make a complaint to the controller under section 164A,
(d)
of the data subject's right to lodge a complaint with the Commission under section 165, and
(e)
of the data subject's right to apply to a court under section 167.

(7)
The controller must—
(a)
record the reasons for a decision to restrict (whether wholly or partly) the provision of information to a data subject under subsection (2) in reliance on subsection (4), and
(b)
if requested to do so by the Commission, make the record available to the Commission.
